purpose: Visual evidence for duplicate detection. Use these image files before deciding that source images are exact duplicates.
duplicateClassificationRule: Archive only images proven to be exact/same-slice/same-screenshot duplicates or unusable. Caption-only similarity is not enough; uncertain or merely similar images stay primary as recognition reinforcement.

entries.caption: Dermoids may be mostly cystic with linear floating echoes (dot and dash sign), consistent with hair . The echogenic shadowing Rokitansky nodule along the periphery is diagnostic for a dermoid.

entries.caption: Cystic lesion with echogenic fat-containing Rokitansky nodule is characteristic for mature cystic teratoma. These lesions can contain tissue from all 3 lines of embryonic cellular differentiation.
